A Trusted Name in Ergonomics for Over 30 Years

Spencer Vandam is the evolution of Backcare & Seating, a family business trusted for decades by homes, workplaces, therapists, architects and  government organisations across Australia. We help people work more comfortably by combining clinically informed advice, well-designed furniture  and long-term support. Whether you need a single chair or a complete fit-out, our role is to make the process easy, professional and reliable.

settings.editor:
Complete Office Fit-Outs

We deliver end-to-end office fit-out solutions for new workplaces, refurbishments and reconfigurations. Working closely with architects, designers, OHS and procurement teams, we combine ergonomic product selection with practical layout planning to create compliant, comfortable and well-considered environments.

From home offices to complex workplace fit-outs, Spencer Vandam delivers ergonomic furniture and environments that support people, meet compliance, and stand the test of time. Built on the legacy of Backcare & Seating, we combine clinical insight, thoughtful design and reliable delivery across Australia.
